purpose: Google Calendar/Tasks transport and authoritative item mapping over the existing planner cache/outbox; no second ledger or scheduler

source_integration.history: Historical durable CalDAV records decode as i_calendar; migrate source callers/fixtures, no alias transport or fallback

identity.account_ref: Host-selected opaque credential reference; token lease must attest this exact account
identity.collection_ref: Exact Calendar calendarId or Tasks tasklistId; no ambient primary/default discovery
identity.item_id: Provider event/task id, never title, iCalUID alone, content similarity or account email
identity.operation_id: Existing durable planner Operation.id; not an RPC id and not a fresh retry id
identity.etag: Provider etag preserved exactly; conditional semantics unsupported/unobserved remain an explicit live gate

api_seams.oauth: Scoped async token-lease provider injected like existing CalDAV credentials; access/refresh/client-secret never serialized into public records or diagnostics
api_seams.wire: Native Google JSON preserved including unknown fields; extend the existing Adapter/ConditionalWrite/WriteOutcome/observation seams only as needed for a real created-item receipt and persisted locator; migrate every affected caller, no duplicate Google outbox
api_seams.format: Add explicit WireFormat to collection/codec selection, owned planner source only; Root updates shared Host/UI routes after handoff
api_seams.fixture_target: Explicit loopback-only fixture transport, never automatic endpoint fallback

safety.calendar_create: Client-selected stable provider-valid event id derived before dispatch from durable operation/item identity; lost insert reconciles by that exact provider id
safety.tasks_create: Tasks assigns ids. Persist a genuine observed insert receipt. Lost response without a provider id stays EffectUnknown; never deduplicate by title/notes/due or inject a visible operation marker into user notes
safety.unknown: No resend, replacement id, account rotation or blind insert after uncertain dispatch
safety.scope: Validate account/collection/phase/token scopes before provider I/O. OAuth expiry is not permission to replay uncertain mutations
safety.time: Preserve Calendar date-only vs RFC3339+timeZone and Task date-only deadlines; DST requires explicit zone/offset, not machine local zone
safety.source_preservation: Local/CalDAV originals and unsupported fields remain readable; no live migration

verification.root: Deterministic real loopback HTTP fixture and actual selected production transport separately; fake tests are not live Google acceptance
required_behaviors: lost Calendar insert receipt reconciles exact id
lost Tasks insert remains unknown without retry
duplicate operation does not dispatch twice
expired or wrong-account lease blocks writes

root: all shared migrations, services, live Google and credential stores
